_removed_services.meilisearch: Retiré en v0.0.2 (commit 3b386a9). La recherche full-text utilise désormais PostgreSQL directement. config/meilisearch.js supprimé.

mailjet.name: Mailjet

initialization.mode: Graceful fallback to dev mode if credentials missing

email_functions: send(options: {to, subject, html, text}) → generic email send
logMailjetAccess(userId, ipAddress, userAgent, action, metadata) → audit trail
mailjet.dev_mode_behavior: Codes are logged instead of sent (logs include verification code)
mailjet.test_approach: DEV MODE (non-production credentials) - NO REAL EMAIL SENDS. All emails logged to console/logs.
mailjet.reason: Service degrades gracefully to dev mode when credentials are missing. No emails sent in dev mode, only logged. Perfect for testing without risk.
mailjet.production_risk: MEDIUM - Email feature disabled if credentials missing, but authentication still works (codes logged to backend)

twilio.name: Twilio

initialization.mode: Graceful fallback to test mode if credentials missing

sms_functions: sendVerificationSms(toPhone, code) → sends SMS with verification code
twilio.test_mode_behavior: SMS codes are logged instead of sent (logs include phone and code)
twilio.test_approach: TEST MODE (non-production credentials) - NO REAL SMS SENDS. All codes logged to console/logs.
twilio.reason: Service gracefully degrades to test mode when credentials are missing. No SMS sent, only logged.
twilio.production_risk: MEDIUM - SMS feature disabled if credentials missing, but authentication still works (codes logged)

redis.name: Redis

initialization.production_enforcement: FATAL error if REDIS_URL missing in production
initialization.fallback_strategy: In-memory cache fallback in development mode

public_functions: set(key, value, ttl=3600) → caches value with TTL
redis.test_approach: HEALTH CHECK ONLY (read-only, non-destructive). Use GET /api/v1/health to verify Redis connectivity. healthCheck() returns status without modifying cache.
redis.reason: Health checks use PING command only (non-destructive). No data modification required to test connectivity.
redis.production_risk: CRITICAL - Application requires Redis in production. Fallback is in-memory only (unsafe for production clusters)

bull_queues.name: Bull Job Queue

initialization.redis_config: Parsed from REDIS_URL (same as Redis cache)
initialization.cleanup_policy: Completed jobs after 24h, Failed jobs after 7d

job_stats_functions: retryFailedJobs(queue, queueName, limit=10) → retries failed jobs
cleanOldJobs(queue, queueName, daysOld=7) → cleanup old jobs
diagnostic_endpoint: GET /api/bull-status (local-only) - Test Bull queue Redis connection
bull_queues.test_approach: READ-ONLY testing via diagnostic endpoint. GET /api/bull-status tests Bull-Redis connectivity without modifying queues. Admin stats endpoints show queue status.
bull_queues.reason: Health checks and stats retrieval are read-only operations. No jobs are modified by diagnostics.
bull_queues.production_risk: MEDIUM - Job failures can impact features (emails, payments, analytics) but queues auto-retry with exponential backoff

firebase_fcm.name: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
env_vars: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (JSON env var or local file)

initialization.mode: Automatic on startup if service account found
initialization.fallback: Graceful disable if service account not found

public_functions: isInitialized() → checks if Firebase is ready
usage: Mobile push notifications (iOS, Android via Expo)
firebase_fcm.fallback_mechanism: /backend/config/push-notification-fallback.js - falls back to Expo push if FCM unavailable
firebase_fcm.test_approach: OPTIONAL - Firebase can be disabled by not providing service account. Health checks via initialization status.
firebase_fcm.reason: Service gracefully disables if credentials missing. Push notification fallback to Expo ensures app stability.
firebase_fcm.production_risk: LOW - Optional feature. If missing, falls back to Expo push notifications

sentry.name: Sentry

initialization.behavior_if_missing: Error tracking disabled, application continues normally

sentry.test_approach: NO TESTING NEEDED - Sentry is read-only, non-invasive monitoring. Missing DSN is safe.
sentry.reason: Sentry is a passive monitoring service. No modifications to production data. If DSN missing, logging is disabled gracefully.

health_check.name: System Health Check
checks_performed: External service status (Sentry, Firebase, Mailjet, Twilio)
health_check.test_approach: READ-ONLY - Health checks are diagnostic-only. GET /api/v1/health does not modify production data.
health_check.reason: Health checks use PING, ECHO, and read-only queries to verify connectivity. Non-destructive.

monitoring.name: Prometheus Metrics & Monitoring Dashboard
monitoring.authentication: Admin-only endpoints require JWT with ADMIN role
monitoring.reason: Monitoring queries do not modify data. Metrics are collected passively.

testing_strategy.summary: Most services can be tested safely with non-destructive health checks and diagnostic queries
requires_actual_configuration: Mailjet (currently disabled, needs API key to test actual sending)
Twilio (currently disabled, needs account SID to test actual SMS)
Firebase (needs service account JSON to test push notifications)

implementation_approach.phase_1_diagnostic: Run health checks and status endpoints (all services, non-destructive)
implementation_approach.phase_2_connectivity: Test individual service connections (Redis PING, PostgreSQL search, Bull queue readiness)
implementation_approach.phase_3_optional: If credentials provided, test actual message sending (Mailjet, Twilio, Firebase)

production_environment.queues: Bull backed by same Redis instance
production_environment.push_notifications: Firebase FCM (NOT CONFIGURED, fallback to Expo)
production_environment.api_base: https://manawa-v0-0-2.onrender.com (production actuelle) — https://api.manawa.ci est le domaine futur planifié, non encore opérationnel

testing: 1. Run GET /api/v1/health to verify all services status
2. Run GET /api/bull-status (local) to test Bull-Redis connectivity
3. Test search endpoints with query params (GET /api/v1/search/global?q=test)
configuration: For production: Add MAILJET credentials for email verification
For production: Add TWILIO credentials for SMS verification
For production: Add FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT for push notifications
For production: Add SENTRY_DSN for error tracking
